context_notes: Project setup is complete and the toolchain is green; nothing has been built yet. The whole roadmap derives from one Vietnamese source document, motonote-v3-flutter.md, which is the sole authority — .planning/intel/ holds the English synthesis of it (decisions.md, constraints.md, context.md; requirements.md is empty by contract because there was no PRD in the ingest set). The single most important architectural fact: all app state is ONE JSON document (appdata.json, under 200 KB), which is why backup is a whole-file upload with no sync protocol, no merge, no conflict resolution. Second most important: lib/domain/ is pure Dart and must never import package:flutter/, so business logic tests run under plain dart test. Recommendation standing at pause time was to discuss Phase 2 before planning Phase 1, because both open questions touch CatalogEntry and Phase 1 builds the data model.
